summary: All six quality dimensions pass. No prior findings were raised, so nothing carries forward as unresolved. The single changed paragraph introduces the ISO APG link with appropriate hedging, correctly attributing it as educational material on evidence; the URL matches the supplied research source. Claims throughout are supported by the supplied sources and appropriately hedged against vendor descriptions and ISO APG guidance. The page stays within its assigned scope across all four subsections without encroaching on adjacent chapters. Prose is readable and non-repetitive. All cited URLs match supplied research source URLs or the permitted internal site path. No FAQ section appears, which is correct as none is assigned. Workflow roles, inputs, decisions, records, and exceptions are present and consistent across all subsections. Illustrative examples are clearly labeled hypothetical.
